title: Reflective Practice
intent: formative · Communication & Reflection (Applying) · click through the process
statement: Pause after a task to turn raw experience into formalised, reusable learning — what worked, what failed, and why.

steps.title: Describe what happened
steps.text: Set down the events plainly, without judging them yet.

steps.title: Examine what worked and failed
steps.text: Separate the parts that went well from the parts that did not.

steps.title: Ask why
steps.text: Dig past the symptom to the cause — reflection is diagnosis, not a diary.

steps.title: Extract the lesson
steps.text: State the general principle you will carry to the next, different task.

steps.title: Plan the change
steps.text: Commit to one concrete thing you will do differently, and when.

feedForward.text: Write one thing that worked, one that did not, the reason behind the second, and the single change you will make next time.
